texts.preamble: Vishnu S/O Shri Badri Prasad B/C Vaishy vs State Of Rajasthan Through Pp on 4 January, 2019 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan Bench At Jaipur S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous (Petition) No. 7913/2018 Vishnu S/o Shri Badri Prasad B/c Vaishy ----Petitioner Versus State Of Rajasthan Through Pp ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Dinesh Kumar Garg For Respondent(s) : Mr. N.S. Dhakad, Pp Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Kanwaljit Singh Ahluwalia Order 04/01/2019
texts.arguments: Counsel for the petitioner has submitted that it is wrongly alleged in the FIR that petitioner was selling synthetic milk. Counsel for the petitioner has drawn attention of this court to Annx.2 report submitted by Food Safety and Standard Laboratory, Alwar(Raj.). As per the report, the sample seized was not of mixed milk but it was conforming the standards of skimmed milk. Counsel for the petitioner has contended that in view of report of Forensic Science Laboratory, petitioner can only be prosecuted for violations of provisions of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Counsel for the petitioner has submitted that it is wrongly alleged in the FIR that petitioner was selling synthetic milk. Counsel for the petitioner has drawn attention of this court to Annx.2 report submitted by Food Safety and Standard Laboratory, Alwar(Raj.). Counsel for the petitioner has contended that in view of report of Forensic Science Laboratory, petitioner can only be prosecuted for violations of provisions of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
